question: Why is famotidine short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.

steps.title: Where our supply is made
steps.purpose: Follow each product's label to the plants it names, and place each plant in FDA's registration file.
steps.finding: 1 plant links on 1 labels; 1 placed in FDA's registration file.

steps.title: What FDA says about this shortage
steps.purpose: Read FDA's current shortage list and its history for this drug.
steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it
steps.purpose: List every labeler of this drug in the same form, and the plants their labels name.
steps.finding: 56 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 6 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 0 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's foreign-key rules over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 12 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 1 of them are this drug.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The famotidine products at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside are labeled by Northwind Health Company, LLC with NDC 51655031220 and SPL set ID ab1cdbbf-d838-020c-e053-2995a90a0f65.
The registered plant for this label is Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) in the USA performing REPACK operations.
FDA inspection 952157 of Northwind Pharmaceuticals LLC (FEI 1831143) ended on 2015-12-09 and was classified OAI, with a known date of 2016-03-08.
The most recent FDA inspection 1256379 ended on 2025-09-26 and was classified VAI, with a known date of 2025-12-04.
Corvale Lakeside holds 14 units at 1.7 per day, giving 8 days on hand, while Corvale General holds 257 units at 9.7 per day, giving 26 days on hand.

rejected.text: Transferring 10 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside would leave Corvale General with 247 units (25 days on hand) and bring Corvale Lakeside to 24 units (14 days on hand).
rejected.reason: number 10 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 3877 days before the posting

dataQuality.rule: famotidine rows the NDC rule rejects
dataQuality.note: LS-LS-0082 "Famotidine 20 mg/1" (NDC blank: blank in source)

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-e8650a.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%famotidine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%famotidine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-2d20ff.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('ab1cdbbf-d838-020c-e053-2995a90a0f65') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-711095.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%famotidine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-2e2337.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%famotidine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-bc4c3d.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%famotidine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-9a8aa8.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1831143') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-d43b7d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1831143') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-089f4a.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1831143') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('northwind health')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-53c6f5.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('northwind health') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%famotidine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-4696e2.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('952157') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-58f4e4.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51655031220')

Q-ac3f96.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%famotidine%'
